scientific_limitations: Ordinary metric finite chains, partial isometric injections, and uniform sampling from nilpotent elements. The scale limit does not establish a centered extreme-value distribution. Full text of the 2018 order-preserving partial-isometry nilpotents paper was inaccessible; publication priority is provisional.
title: Exact rank–nilpotency-index census and typical depth of finite-chain partial isometries
